szenen.text: Warning for every iPhone user with crypto. One ad can be enough to steal your seed phrase.
Security firm Confiant tracked a hacker group running these ads in forty-seven countries, across more than four hundred eighty ad domains since May.
You see a normal ad. You open the page. An invisible frame checks your iPhone, reads your iOS version and picks one of four exploit kits. No download. No click on anything else.
They take everything: wallet seed phrases, saved passwords, messages and photos.
At risk: iPhones on iOS 18 or older, with wallets like MetaMask, Phantom or Trust Wallet. The flaw is in iOS itself, not in the wallet apps.
Remember the Trust Wallet drains on iPhones? We think this could be part of the answer.
Do this today: update to iOS 26, turn on Lockdown Mode if you can't update, never keep your seed phrase in Notes or Photos, and keep big amounts on a hardware wallet.
